title: Before the feast: knowing his hour had come
english: [[Before the feast of the Passover, Jesus knowing that his hour had come to depart from this world to the Father… >> Bible:John 13:1]]
[[He loved them to the end. >> Bible:John 13:1]] Love to the end reaches as far as the cross.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Supper underway; the devil had already put it into Judas
english: [[And during supper, the devil having already put it into the heart that Judas should betray him… >> Bible:John 13:2]]
The cast into the heart toward betrayal is not without the devil.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: He rises from supper and lays aside his garments
english: [[He rises from supper, lays aside his garments, and taking a towel girded himself. >> Bible:John 13:4]]
As the passion arrangement seeks what he was about to do, he prefigures the emptying by laying aside the garments.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: He pours water and begins to wash the disciples’ feet
english: [[Then he pours water into the basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet. >> Bible:John 13:5]]
Not only the bath before supper, but after dining a second water for the feet alone.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Peter: You will never wash my feet
english: He comes to Simon Peter, who says, [[“Lord, are you washing my feet?” >> Bible:John 13:6]] … [[“You will never wash my feet.” >> Bible:John 13:8]]
We will use what Peter now says in due time as an example of human reverence.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: If I do not wash you, you have no share with me
english: Jesus answered, [[“If I do not wash you, you have no share with me.” >> Bible:John 13:8]]
Ask whether you have no share at all if I do not wash you, or not with me the teacher and Lord, yet with those lesser than me.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: The one who has bathed needs only to wash the feet
english: Simon Peter said, [[“Lord, not my feet only but also my hands and my head.” >> Bible:John 13:9]]
[[“The one who has bathed has no need to wash, except for the feet, but is entirely clean.” >> Bible:John 13:10]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: You are clean, but not all
english: [[“And you are clean, but not all.” >> Bible:John 13:10]] For he knew who was betraying him.
Those genuinely discipled are clean; the betrayer has not been cleansed.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Let us offer our feet to Jesus who still rises from supper
english: Therefore let us offer our feet to Jesus even now as he rises from supper,
so that by washing he may cleanse the lowest pollutions of the soul.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Do you know what I have done to you?
english: When he had washed their feet… he said, [[“Do you know what I have done to you?” >> Bible:John 13:12]]
Those who grasp the greatness of Jesus’ power likely understand what he did in washing the feet.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: You call me Teacher and Lord, and you say well
english: [[“You call me Teacher and Lord, and you say well, for so I am.” >> Bible:John 13:13]]
[[“If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.” >> Bible:John 13:14]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: I gave you an example
english: [[“For I gave you an example, that you also should do as I did to you.” >> Bible:John 13:15]]
The example is not only bodily but also of the Word’s humility.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: A slave is not greater than his lord
english: [[“Truly, truly, I say to you, a slave is not greater than his lord, nor an apostle greater than the one who sent him.” >> Bible:John 13:16]]
[[“If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.” >> Bible:John 13:17]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: I am not speaking of you all; the Scripture must be fulfilled
english: [[“I am not speaking of you all; I know whom I have chosen. But that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats my bread has lifted his heel against me.’” >> Bible:John 13:18]]
The Scripture is fulfilled concerning the betrayer.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: I tell you now before it happens
english: [[“From now on I tell you before it happens, so that when it happens you may believe that I am.” >> Bible:John 13:19]]
The foretelling strengthens faith toward the “I am.”
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Whoever receives the one I send receives me
english: [[“Truly, truly, I say to you, whoever receives anyone I send receives me, and whoever receives me receives the one who sent me.” >> Bible:John 13:20]]
A chain of sending: from the Father through the Son to the apostles.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Jesus was troubled in spirit: one of you will betray me
english: Having said this, [[Jesus was troubled in spirit and testified, “Truly, truly, I say to you that one of you will betray me.” >> Bible:John 13:21]]
The troubling of spirit is sympathy and disclosure of what is coming.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: The disciples looked at one another, uncertain
english: [[The disciples looked at one another, uncertain about whom he spoke. >> Bible:John 13:22]]
The perplexity belongs to the clean; they do not know the defiled one.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: The disciple whom Jesus loved reclining on his breast
english: [[One of his disciples was reclining on Jesus’ breast, the one Jesus loved. >> Bible:John 13:23]]
[[So Simon Peter motions to him to ask who it might be of whom he speaks. >> Bible:John 13:24]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Lord, who is it?
english: Leaning back thus on Jesus’ chest, that one says to him, [[“Lord, who is it?” >> Bible:John 13:25]]
Nearness of the beloved gives boldness for the question.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: It is the one to whom I will give the morsel
english: Jesus answers, [[“It is the one to whom I will give this morsel when I have dipped it.” >> Bible:John 13:26]]
Having dipped the morsel, he gives it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 32 CLOSEOUT.

title: After the morsel, Satan entered into him
english: [[And after the morsel, Satan entered into him. >> Bible:John 13:27]]
Jesus said to him, [[“What you are doing, do quickly.” >> Bible:John 13:27]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 32 CLOSEOUT.

title: No one at the table knew why he said this
english: [[None of those reclining knew why he said this to him. >> Bible:John 13:28]]
Some thought, since Judas held the moneybag, that he was telling him, [[“Buy what we need for the feast.” >> Bible:John 13:29]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 32 CLOSEOUT.

title: Having received the morsel, he went out immediately; and it was night
english: [[So after receiving the morsel he went out immediately; and it was night. >> Bible:John 13:30]]
Night is a symbol of the darkness into which the betrayer goes out.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 32 CLOSEOUT.

title: Now the Son of Man is glorified
english: When he had gone out, Jesus said, [[“Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in him.” >> Bible:John 13:31]]
The betrayer’s exit is the beginning of the glory according to the passion.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 32 CLOSEOUT.

title: God will glorify him in himself
english: [[“If God is glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and will glorify him at once.” >> Bible:John 13:32]]
The return of glory from the Father to the Son does not delay.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 32 CLOSEOUT.

title: Little children, I am with you a little while longer
english: [[“Little children, I am with you a little while longer. You will seek me; and as I said to the Jews… I now say to you also.” >> Bible:John 13:33]]
‘A little while’ is the short span of presence toward the passion.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 32 CLOSEOUT.

title: A new commandment: love one another
english: [[“A new commandment I give you, that you love one another: just as I have loved you, you also are to love one another.” >> Bible:John 13:34]]
New not by time alone but by the measure of the Son’s love.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 32 CLOSEOUT.

title: By this all will know you are my disciples
english: [[“By this all will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.” >> Bible:John 13:35]]
The sign of discipleship is love among yourselves — not words or powers alone.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 32 CLOSEOUT.

title: Peter: Lord, where are you going?
english: Simon Peter said to him, [[“Lord, where are you going?” >> Bible:John 13:36]] He answered, [[“Where I am going you cannot follow me now, but you will follow later.” >> Bible:John 13:36]]
Inability now; later following through martyrdom.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 32 CLOSEOUT.

title: I will lay down my life for you
english: Peter said to him, [[“Lord, why can I not follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.” >> Bible:John 13:37]]
The eagerness is great; the trial is still lacking.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 32 CLOSEOUT.

title: The rooster will not crow until you deny me; close of Book 32
english: Jesus answered, [[“Will you lay down your life for me? Truly, truly, I say to you, the rooster will not crow until you have denied me three times.” >> Bible:John 13:38]]
So much for the thirty-second tome on the basin, the betrayal, and the new commandment.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 32 CLOSEOUT.
